mvp_baseline: Owner-approved local-first Windows sales core P0; P1 modules optional; execution authorization remains limited to D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31 and D-32.
change_summary: Implemented the H-04 security package (D-32): cookie authentication on the existing User table, PBKDF2-SHA256 password hashing, SecurityStamp-based session invalidation, audit log, permission policies and first-run setup.
Added login lockout after repeated failures, automatic deactivation of accounts still using the default passwords, and removed the hard-coded credentials from Program.cs.
Tightened the role matrix: Manager loses ManageUsers, BackupRestore and ManagePermissions; CancelSale and ModifySale were added for Manager and Admin.
Added the AddAuditLogsAndUserSecurityStamp migration with the AuditLogs table and a backfilled SecurityStamp column, and added AuditLogs to the required backup tables.
Updated the verified test counts to Domain 24/24 and Integration 262/262 (286 total).
Kept the approved MVP scope and the Phase 3 boundary (cash, purchases, UI, sync) unchanged and unauthorized.
review_findings: H-04 evidence: dotnet build Release = 0 errors; Domain 24/24; Integration 262/262; 17 new tests cover PBKDF2 hashing, password policy, the role matrix, SecurityStamp rotation, login lockout, audit persistence and the migration upgrade.

HTTP smoke test on a temporary SQLite database: /, /settings, /products and /reports redirect to /login; /login and /setup return 200; creating the admin via /setup then logging in opens /settings; POST /auth/logout invalidates the session; /setup is closed once an active admin exists.
Execution remains unauthorized outside the recorded limited scopes (D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32).
Phase 3 (cash drawer, purchases, UI, sync) is not implemented and not authorized.
